facts.fact: Madagascar's PIC 3 project, supported by three ministries, gave each of 43 startups chosen from 271 applications a US$15,000 grant under the Miary Digital programme, 50% already paid, per project coordinator Ladislas Adrien Rakotondrazaka.

systems.owner: PIC 3 project, with ministries MEF, MNDPT and MIC

facts.fact: Three partner incubators, Orange Digital Center Madagascar, NextA and Zafy Tody, gave the 43 Miary Digital startups a year of intensive support, the document reports.
facts.system: Orange Digital Center Madagascar, NextA, Zafy Tody

MDG.note: First cohort concentrated in Analamanga; no second city stated.
